sections.text: RootRecord news update for October 3, 2026. National security. Breaking Defense reports that Army to establish new autonomy command, acquisition executive. The service’s new command will be called Army Futures and Autonomous Systems Command, or FASCOM, according to a memo signed by Acting Army Secretary Adam Telle. Breaking Defense reports that GDIT replaces longtime president Gilliland. Paul Nedzbala, who joined GDIT in 2018, has been appointed acting president. the U.K. Ministry of Defence reports that Joint Statement from Defence Ministers of the Joint Expeditionary Force: 02 October 2026. Defence Ministers of the Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF) and Allies met at Keflavik Air Base, Iceland, today (02 October) to advance the JEF's role as a key pillar of European and Euro-Atlantic security.
